utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Focusing on the old playground equipment, like the broken swing? I want to make sure that's the main priority before we gather supplies.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: So you think we should start with the playground? Has anyone checked what tools we actually have yet?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Good point, Mina. We should definitely check the tool inventory first to know what we're missing before diving in.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: It's this Saturday, Oren. Bring that toaster along!

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Wait, a toaster? I thought we were fixing the Johnsons' fence.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Oh, the toaster's just one of the items folks are bringing for general repairs. But you're right, helping the Johnsons with their fence is definitely on the list for Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: So Kira, don't forget—the repair drive is this weekend! We're meeting at my place at 10, then heading over to fix Mrs. Chen's fence. Bring your toolbox!

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, so it's actually happening? You're serious about the repair drive this weekend?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely! We're starting with bikes and appliances at my place, then Mrs. Chen's fence—I've got it all planned out!

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Faye, you should come to the repair drive this weekend—they're fixing up bikes, appliances, and even furniture. It'll be fun!

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Oh, I heard it's been moved to Sunday at the community center now, so that should work better with my school pickup schedule.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Perfect, Sunday at the community center works great! I'll see you there—maybe we can team up on fixing some old chairs.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Cleo, do you know if the repair drive is still happening at the community center on Oak Street? I heard it might be canceled.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Oh, it's still happening! It was moved to Sunday at the community center—not canceled. I'll be bringing my toolbox.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Sunday? Good, I'll mark my calendar. I was worried it got scrapped after Kira said it was just talk.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, I'm pretty sure it's that swing set at the park... or maybe there's more to it? I keep mixing up the details.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: It's the whole playground, actually—swings, benches, and a few other spots. We're meeting at the park this Saturday at 10. You in?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Saturday at 10? Yeah, I think I can make it—wait, that's the day I have that thing... or maybe not?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Well, I need to get this straight: is it donations or actual repairs? I don't like surprises with my schedule.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Both. Drop off usable items or come help fix things. Your call.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Alright, I'll stick to dropping off a few old tools then. I like knowing exactly what I'm doing.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I've been telling everyone about this Saturday's repair drive at the community center—they're really going to need all the old appliances we can scrounge up!

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: But do we even have a plan for collecting those appliances? I haven't seen any sign-up sheets or drop-off points yet.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I think they're just having people bring stuff directly to the community center Saturday morning—no need for formal sign-ups or anything like that!

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, the community center on Oak Street this weekend, right? Hope it's quick.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yeah, that's the one. Shouldn't take too long if we all pitch in.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Good, I'm counting on it. I've got a packed schedule, so let's get it done fast.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great, so you're interested! It's this Saturday at the community center, 10 to 4. I'll be there fixing up old lamps.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That sounds nice, Mara. What should I bring if I decide to come?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Just bring any broken household items you'd like to fix, or come by to lend a hand—we'll have tools and materials ready!

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Nell, I'm glad I ran into you—are you all set for the repair drive on Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, hey Ira! I've been hearing bits and pieces about it—what exactly are we supposed to bring again?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I think just basic tools like hammers, screwdrivers, and maybe some paintbrushes. I'm grabbing a few extra supplies myself.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Gus! Great to see you. Just a quick update—the repair drive has been moved to Sunday at the community center instead of Saturday. Hope you can still make it!

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks for the heads-up, Rosa! Sunday works for me—I'll still be there with my tools.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Wonderful, Gus! I'm glad Sunday works for you. What kind of tools are you planning to bring?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Faye, I just wanted to make sure you heard we're doing the repair drive this Sunday at the community center now, not Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Yeah, Rosa, thanks for the heads-up—I've got it on my calendar now. I'll mention it to the other parents at pickup.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great, thanks Faye! And if anyone needs a hand hauling their items over, just let me know—I can help coordinate that too.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, the repair drive's at the community center on Oak Street this weekend? I hope it wraps up quick—I've got errands to run.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yeah, same here—I promised the wife I'd be back by early afternoon. Let's get it sorted quickly.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Alright, let's knock it out fast then. I'll meet you there right when it starts.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Hey Mara, I'm still thinking about it—Mina was curious too, so maybe we'll come together.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right, the repair drive! I think I remember now—Mina was interested too, wasn't she? What day did we say it was again?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yeah, Saturday. Mina seemed interested when I mentioned it, so maybe we'll head over together.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey Uli, thanks again for offering to grab those small parts—I really appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Sure, Gus. I'll head to the hardware store this afternoon and pick up what's needed.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Uli. I'll text you the list of screws and brackets we need—and if the store has any spare washers, grab a few too.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I've got four volunteers confirmed, but I'm still unsure if that's enough to finish before dark if we're starting late.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Well, starting late sure throws off the plan. I could lend a hand for a couple hours, but I need to know the exact start time first.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: If he picks up the wood tomorrow morning, then maybe we can aim for a 1 PM start?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yeah, got tools from Sam. Saturday morning. Shouldn't take more than a few hours.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Is it still at the community center on Oak Street? I want to make sure I'm heading to the right place.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yes, same place. Oak Street community center, 9 AM.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Hey Quinn, I heard we're collecting stuff for the playground—do they need any old tools I might have lying around?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely! They're looking for anything from tools to flower pots—just bring your old stuff by the community center this Saturday!

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That's perfect! I've got a dusty old hammer and some flower pots in the shed—I'll bring them over on Saturday!

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Oh, thanks for the heads-up about the change—Sunday at the community center works much better for me. So I'll bring my toolbox with screwdrivers and pliers; that should come in handy for the small appliances and furniture.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Great, I'll grab an extra pack of screws and some wood glue while I'm out—those always go fast on repair days.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Good thinking, Ira! I'll make sure to bring my screwdriver set too—between the two of us we should have everything covered.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hey Jules, how many volunteers have you rounded up for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I've got about five folks so far, plus Vik said he'd bring a few more—should be a solid crew to fix up all those bikes and old furniture!

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Five, huh? That's a good start. Need me to ask around the block for more hands?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Oh, Hana, just the person I wanted to see! You're still coming to the repair drive with me on Saturday, right?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Yes, I'm still coming—I just want to double-check what we're going to fix so I can bring the right tools.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great, I've got a few broken lamps and a wobbly chair—bring a screwdriver set and maybe some wire strippers if you have them!

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, hey Tess! The repair drive—yeah, I think it's the playground stuff, right? Or did you say there was more to it?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh no, it's not just the playground—it's a whole thing where folks are fixing up old appliances and tools over at the community center! I've been telling everyone I can.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Wait, the community center? Huh, I thought it was just the swing set. Did someone decide to add more stuff?
